items.title: Pay service-charge balance (Betriebskostennachzahlung)
items.quote: Den Betrag von 263,18 € zahlen Sie bitte binnen 30 Tagen nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung.
items.computation: The letter sets a 30-day period running from 'Zugang dieser Abrechnung' (the day the statement is received), not from a printed document date. The letter carries no date at all (no 'Beispielwetzlar, den ...' line or similar), so the start of the period (the day of Zugang) cannot be fixed from the letter itself. The sender is a private landlord/property manager, not a public authority, so the statutory deemed-delivery rules for administrative letters (e.g. the 3/4-day fiction) do not apply; only the actual day of receipt counts, and that day is not stated. Without a known receipt date, the 30-day period under §§ 187, 188 BGB cannot be counted to an exact calendar day. Earliest plausible reading: if received on the same day the letter was sent, counting would start the next day and run 30 days, shifted to the next business day if it fell on a weekend/holiday in NW — but this is speculative since no date is given.

warnings: The letter itself bears no printed date anywhere (no sender's date line), so the 30-day payment period, which runs from the day of receipt ('Zugang'), cannot be computed to an exact due date; ask the person for the postmark or the day the letter actually arrived to fix it.

The IBAN printed (DE18 3705 0198 0005 5773 00) is a validly formed German domestic IBAN matching the sender's stated bank (Musterbank AG); this only confirms the IBAN's format, not that the account belongs to the landlord, so compare it with earlier rent correspondence before paying.
